name: Nin-Dog Alpha

entries.name: Aura: Frightening Aura
entries.text: All hostile creatures within 10 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw against your highest saving throw. On a failed save, they gain 1 rank of Fear while inside this aura, or for one minute. A feared creature remakes this saving throw at the end of each of its turns.

entries.name: Bestial Aggression
entries.text: You have innate aggressive tendencies based on your species. You gain advantage on your first attack made against the last creature that targeted you with an attack.

entries.name: Uncanny Senses
entries.text: Immune to the surprised condition. +5 bonus to Perception (already added).
This adversary is one born of the wild. It gains a +1 bonus to hit and damage for every allied creature within 5 feet of it.

entries.name: Elite Striker
entries.text: This adversary gains a +1 bonus to Taijutsu, Bukijutsu, and weapon attack bonuses. Also, increase the number of weapon attacks by 1 (added).

entries.name: Striker (Taijutsu) Passive
entries.text: Once per turn, your weapon, Taijutsu, and Bukijutsu damage ignores up to 10 damage reduction.

entries.name: Striker (Taijutsu) Action
entries.text: By spending 4 Tenacity dice, this adversary can Overpower the next Taijutsu or Bukijutsu it casts. The overpowered jutsu adds the Tenacity die to its damage and imposes a 1d4 penalty on creatures forced to make a saving throw against the jutsu cast. Additionally, if the jutsu cast scores a critical hit, increase the attack's damage die by 1 step.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: The Nin-Dog Alpha may make three bite attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. If this attack deals damage, the Nin-Dog Alpha may attempt to grapple the target as a free action. It has advantage on grapple checks against creatures smaller than itself.

The Nin-Dog Alpha takes one Elite Action at the end of another creature's turn, once each round, to either move, attack, cast a jutsu, or spend its Elite Action to gain an additional reaction. It regains spent Elite Actions at the beginning of each of its turns.

notes: Printed as a Large Beast companion of the Inuzuka clan; clan_slug groups it with the Inuzuka templates. Passive Perception 32 is 10 + the +7 Perception skill + Bestial Senses' +10 + Uncanny Senses' +5, although Uncanny Senses says its +5 is already included in the skill.
